targetTexts.1: “Indeed, my eyes have seen all this; my ears have heard and understood.
targetTexts.2: What you know, I also know; I am not inferior to you.
targetTexts.3: Yet I desire to speak to the Almighty and argue my case before God.
targetTexts.4: You, however, smear with lies; you are all worthless physicians.
targetTexts.5: If only you would remain silent; for that would be your wisdom!
targetTexts.6: Hear now my argument, and listen to the plea of my lips.
targetTexts.7: Will you speak wickedly on God’s behalf or speak deceitfully for Him?
targetTexts.8: Would you show Him partiality or argue in His defense?
targetTexts.9: Would it be well when He examined you? Could you deceive Him as you would deceive a man?
targetTexts.10: Surely He would rebuke you if you secretly showed partiality.
targetTexts.11: Would His majesty not terrify you? Would the dread of Him not fall upon you?
targetTexts.12: Your maxims are proverbs of ashes; your defenses are defenses of clay.
targetTexts.13: Be silent, and I will speak. Then let come to me what may.
targetTexts.14: Why do I put myself at risk and take my life in my own hands?
targetTexts.15: Though He slay me, I will hope in Him. I will still defend my ways to His face.
targetTexts.16: Moreover, this will be my salvation, for no godless man can appear before Him.
targetTexts.17: Listen carefully to my words; let my declaration ring in your ears.
targetTexts.18: See now, I have prepared my case; I know that I will be vindicated.
targetTexts.19: Can anyone indict me? If so, I will be silent and die.
targetTexts.20: Only grant these two things to me, so that I need not hide from You:
targetTexts.21: Withdraw Your hand from me, and do not let Your terror frighten me.
targetTexts.22: Then call me, and I will answer, or let me speak, and You can reply.
targetTexts.23: How many are my iniquities and sins? Reveal to me my transgression and sin.
targetTexts.24: Why do You hide Your face and consider me as Your enemy?
targetTexts.25: Would You frighten a windblown leaf? Would You chase after dry chaff?
targetTexts.26: For You record bitter accusations against me and bequeath to me the iniquities of my youth.
targetTexts.27: You put my feet in the stocks and stand watch over all my paths; You set a limit for the soles of my feet.
targetTexts.28: So man wastes away like something rotten, like a moth-eaten garment.
